description: Validate JSON text, identify its root type, and return compact normalized JSON (object keys sorted) plus a SHA-256 hash of it. Use it to check model or API output before parsing, or to compare two documents by hash; to read one field use json_extract. Runs without network access and does not store your input. Input up to 100,000 bytes (larger input is an error); trailing data after the first value counts as invalid. Returns valid, root_type, normalized_json, bytes and sha256; invalid JSON returns valid false with the parser error instead of failing. normalized_json escapes <, > and & as \u003c, \u003e and \u0026, and sha256 is the hash of that string.

json.description: JSON text to validate, up to 100 KB.

l402_proof.description: L402 payment proof "<macaroon>:<preimage>". Omit on the first call; an unpaid call returns a 0 sat Lightning invoice and the macaroon. Pay the invoice, then repeat the call with this argument set.

name: json_validate
